Agility.name: Brimhaven Agility Arena
Agility.summary: Brimhaven Agility Arena offers the fastest experience from level 20 to 47.

Agility.name: Wilderness Agility Course
Agility.summary: The Wilderness Agility Course offers the fastest experience rates from level 47 to 62.

Agility.name: Hallowed Sepulchre
Agility.summary: The Hallowed Sepulchre offers the fastest experience from level 62 onwards.

Agility.name: Rooftop Agility Courses
Agility.summary: Rooftop Agility Courses are slower but straightforward and less attention-intensive alternatives to the faster training methods.

Agility.name: Edgeville Dungeon monkeybars
Agility.summary: Repeatedly crossing the monkeybar shortcut in the Edgeville Dungeon offers up to 13,200 experience per hour.

Agility.name: Agility Pyramid
Agility.summary: The Agility Pyramid is a straightforward, profitable method of training Agility with little requirements.

Agility.name: Brimhaven Agility Arena
Agility.summary: The Brimhaven Agility Arena offers a different approach to training Agility.

Agility.name: Ape Atoll Agility Course
Agility.summary: The Ape Atoll Agility Course is a viable alternative for players who have completed chapter 2 of Monkey Madness I.

Agility.name: Shayzien Advanced Agility Course
Agility.summary: The Shayzien Advanced Agility Course is an alternative for players who cannot access the Ape Atoll Agility Course or do not wish to train on the Wilderness Agility Course.

Agility.name: Colossal Wyrm Agility Course
Agility.summary: The Colossal Wyrm Agility Course is a less click-intensive course that offers an alternative way to get Amylase crystals.

Agility.name: Werewolf Agility Course
Agility.summary: The Werewolf Agility Course is an alternative for those who seek for both decent experience rates and marks of grace.

Agility.name: Prifddinas Agility Course
Agility.summary: The Prifddinas Agility Course offers a less click-intensive training option from level 75 onwards, being similar to the Rooftop Agility Courses.

Construction.name: Oak larders
Construction.summary: From level 33 to 52, build oak larders in the Kitchen.

Construction.name: Mahogany furniture
Construction.summary: Building mahogany furniture becomes the fastest viable training method at level 52.

Construction.name: Mahogany Homes
Construction.summary: Mahogany Homes is a cheaper and less click-intensive alternative to the faster methods.

Construction.name: Shipwrights' workbench
Construction.summary: Boat repair kits and hull parts can be constructed at a shipwrights' workbench near a bank and resold to other players, which is different from most other Construction training methods which use resources without producing items.

Construction.name: Mounted mythical capes
Construction.summary: Mounted mythical capes are a cheaper alternative to mahogany or other teak furniture.

Construction.name: Teak garden benches
Construction.summary: Building teak garden benches is the fastest way to use teak planks.

Construction.name: Oak doors
Construction.summary: Building oak doors is a cheaper and less click-intensive alternative to mahogany or teak furniture.

Cooking.name: Cooked karambwan
Cooking.summary: Completion of the quest Tai Bwo Wannai Trio is required to successfully cook karambwan.

Cooking.name: Bake Pie
Cooking.summary: Completion of the quest Lunar Diplomacy is required to cast Bake Pie.

Cooking.name: Jug of wine
Cooking.summary: Making jugs of wine offers fast experience, though requires more attention than cooking fish or casting Bake Pie.

Cooking.name: Cooking fish
Cooking.summary: Cooking various fish is a cheap or profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods.

Crafting.name: Cutting gems
Crafting.summary: Cutting (uncut) gems offers the fastest experience up to level 77.

Crafting.name: Battlestaves
Crafting.summary: Crafting battlestaves offers relatively fast experience and is usually cheaper compared to other methods.

Crafting.name: D'hide bodies
Crafting.summary: Crafting d'hide bodies becomes the fastest viable training method from level 77 onwards.

Crafting.name: Molten glass
Crafting.summary: Blowing molten glass with a glassblowing pipe offers very slow experience rates, but it requires little attention and a low amount of capital.

Crafting.name: Crafting jewellery
Crafting.summary: Starting at level 5, players can begin crafting gold jewellery using a gold bar and the appropriate mould at a furnace.

Crafting.name: Spinning and weaving yarn
Crafting.summary: With the addition of Sailing, raw materials can be spun into balls of yarn and further woven into bolts of fabric for crafting experience and in some cases, a small profit.

Crafting.name: Crafting drift nets
Crafting.summary: Drift nets can be crafted from 2 jute fibre each.

Crafting.name: Golem Crafting
Crafting.summary: Golem crafting is a Crafting training method located on the island of Wyrmscraig that serves as an alternative to glassblowing at higher levels.

Crafting.name: Cutting amethyst
Crafting.summary: Cutting amethyst into ranging material with a chisel will often yield very small losses (or even profits) while also granting more experience than glassblowing, making it a viable method for those who are willing to sacrifice the speed of other methods for che

Defence.name: Sulphur Naguas
Defence.summary: requirements: Partial completion of Perilous Moons (includes {{SCP

Defence.name: Maniacal monkeys with Hallowfell
Defence.summary: See Maniacal monkey/Strategies for more information.name: Maniacal monkey

Firemaking.name: Creating pyre logs
Firemaking.summary: 1-tick creating pyre logs offers the fastest experience up to level 30.

Firemaking.name: Burning logs
Firemaking.summary: Burning logs is one of the fastest ways to train Firemaking.

Firemaking.name: Burning logs on a campfire
Firemaking.summary: Burning logs on a forester's campfire is a low-effort alternative to the faster methods.

Firemaking.name: Wintertodt
Firemaking.summary: Subduing Wintertodt from level 50 Firemaking onwards is a slower, but profitable and low-effort alternative to burning logs.

Fishing.name: Fly fishing

notes: One option needs The Depths of Despair

Fishing.summary: 3-tick fly fishing trout and salmon offers the fastest Fishing experience up to level 58 when using tick manipulation.

Fishing.name: Drift net fishing
Fishing.summary: Drift net fishing is the most efficient way to train both Fishing and Hunter at the same time.

Fishing.name: Barbarian Fishing
Fishing.summary: 3-tick Barbarian Fishing becomes one of the fastest training methods at level 58.

Fishing.name: 2-tick harpooning swordfish/tuna
Fishing.summary: 2-tick harpooning swordfish and tuna offers the fastest Fishing experience.

Fishing.name: Leechfin Fishing
Fishing.summary: Leechfin fishing is a high-intensity training method that offers competitive experience rates, sitting between 3-tick barbarian fishing and 2-tick harpooning swordfish/tuna.

Fishing.name: Tempoross
Fishing.summary: Fighting the Tempoross on mass worlds offers relatively fast experience and requires fairly low amount of effort compared to the tick manipulation methods.

Fishing.name: Aerial fishing
Fishing.summary: Aerial fishing is a viable alternative method to train both Fishing and Hunter, offering similar experience to drift net fishing, but without the extra requirement of needing to supply drift nets.

Fishing.name: Monkfish
Fishing.summary: Catching monkfish at the Piscatoris Fishing Colony is a profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods.

Fishing.name: Karambwan
Fishing.summary: Catching karambwan is a profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods.

Fishing.name: Infernal eel
Fishing.summary: Catching infernal eels in the inner part of Mor Ul Rek is a profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods.

Fishing.name: Minnows
Fishing.summary: Catching minnows offers relatively slow experience, but it can provide decent profit depending on the Grand Exchange price of raw sharks.

Fishing.name: Anglerfish
Fishing.summary: At level 82 Fishing, you can start catching anglerfish in Port Piscarilius.

Fishing.name: Dark crabs
Fishing.summary: Catching dark crabs inside the Resource Area becomes a viable low-effort option after completing the elite Wilderness Diary.

Fishing.name: Sacred eel
Fishing.summary: At level 87 and after partially completing Regicide, catching sacred eels at Zul-Andra becomes a profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods.

Fletching.name: Cutting gems into bolt tips
Fletching.summary: Cutting gems into bolt tips can be done during downtime before attaching them to bolts.

Fletching.name: Partial loop
Fletching.summary: Players who haven't yet acquired a log basket only have enough inventory space to build 5 totems per loop.

Fletching.name: Full loop
Fletching.summary: A log basket allows players to build all eight totems during each loop.

Fletching.name: Arrow shafts
Fletching.summary: Arrow shaft The best way to get from level 1 to level 5 is by fletching arrow shafts, which give 5 experience per log.

Fletching.name: Battlestaves
Fletching.summary: Celastrus bark Fletching battlestaves requires one piece of Celastrus bark, and yields 80 experience per bark.

Fletching.name: Redwood shields
Fletching.summary: Redwood shield Redwood shields are an alternative method to fletching bows.

Herblore.name: Making potions
Herblore.summary: For more in depth calculations and variations about the cost per experience, see Calculator:Herblore/Potions.

Herblore.name: Making tar
Herblore.summary: An alternative, potentially cheaper method of training Herblore is making tar.

Herblore.name: Mastering Mixology
Herblore.summary: At level 60 and with completion of Children of the Sun, players can go to Aldarin and take part in the Mastering Mixology minigame, however it will become more efficient at higher levels, with the last unlock at level 81 Herblore.

Hunter.name: Feldip weasels
Hunter.summary: From level 9 to 15, catch feldip weasels in the Feldip Hunter area.

Hunter.name: Ruby harvests
Hunter.summary: From level 15 to 21, catch ruby harvests while trapping copper longtails at the Piscatoris hunter area.

Hunter.name: Red crabs
Hunter.summary: Requires partial completion of Pandemonium and 10 Construction to build the crab traps.

Hunter.name: Embertailed jerboas
Hunter.summary: Requires partial completion of the Eagles' Peak quest to be able to set box traps.

Hunter.name: Razor-backed kebbits
Hunter.summary: From the level 49 to 73, catch razor-backed kebbits at the Piscatoris hunter area.

Hunter.name: Hunters' Rumours
Hunter.summary: Players can choose to complete Hunters' Rumours assigned by Guild hunters in the Hunter Guild.

Hunter.name: Black chinchompas
Hunter.summary: Requires partial completion of the Eagles' Peak quest to be able to set box traps.

Hunter.name: Sapphire glacialis
Hunter.summary: From level 25 to 39, equip a butterfly net and catch sapphire glacialis.

Hunter.name: Swamp lizards
Hunter.summary: At levels 37 to 43 players can catch swamp lizards north-west of Slepe.

Hunter.name: Orange salamanders
Hunter.summary: Catching orange salamanders is a slower but less click-intensive alternative to falconry.

Hunter.name: Maniacal monkeys
Hunter.summary: Maniacal monkeys are a low-effort alternative to the faster training methods, requiring interaction once every 25-30 seconds.

Hunter.name: Red salamanders
Hunter.summary: From level 60 to 67, catch red salamanders south of the entrance to the Ourania Cave.

Hunter.name: Black salamanders
Hunter.summary: From level 67 to 73, catch black salamanders in the Bone Yard Hunter area in the Wilderness.

Hunter.name: Moonlight moths
Hunter.summary: Capturing moonlight moths in the Northern section of the Earthbound Cavern in the ruins of Neypotzli is a click-intensive but fast way of levelling Hunter upon reaching level 75.

Hunter.name: Rainbow crabs
Hunter.summary: Trapping rainbow crabs becomes a straightforward alternative at level 77 Hunter and 64 Sailing.

Hunter.name: Carnivorous chinchompas
Hunter.summary: Requires partial completion of the Eagles' Peak quest to be able to set box traps.

Hunter.name: Herbiboar
Hunter.summary: Tracking the herbiboar on Fossil Island is a fairly low-effort alternative to the faster training methods.

Hunter.name: Stymphikes
Hunter.summary: Starting at 82 Hunter, stymphikes become a low-effort way to train the skill, with players only needing to click 3 times every 45 seconds.

Magic.name: High Level Alchemy
Magic.summary: At level 55, cast High Level Alchemy (commonly known as "alching") to convert various items into coins.

Magic.name: Bursting/barraging on Ancient Magicks
Magic.summary: After completing the Desert Treasure I quest, the player unlocks Ancient Magicks.

Magic.name: Cure Me
Magic.summary: Starting at level 71 Magic, or as early as level 65 with access to boosts, casting Cure Me from the Lunar spellbook can achieve up to 414,000 experience per hour optimally, costing -3930000 per hour, not including Prayer potions.

Magic.name: Potion share
Magic.summary: Starting at level 81 Magic, or earlier with access to boosts, casting Stat Restore Pot Share from the Lunar spellbook can achieve up to around 140,000 experience per hour optimally, costing -658950 per hour, assuming a Mud battlestaff or similar is used to sav

Magic.name: Tele-alching
Magic.summary: "Tele-alching" is a method which combines the two elements of casting High Level Alchemy and teleporting.

Mining.name: Iron ore
Mining.summary: Players who are inexperienced with tick manipulation methods, or do not plan to use tick manipulation at all, are advised to mine iron up to level 70 and continuing with other methods such as the [[#Levels 70-99: Volcanic Mine|Volcanic Mine]].

Mining.name: Granite
Mining.summary: 3-tick mining granite (commonly referred to as "3t4g", 3-tick 4 granite) at the quarry or Cape Conch mine offers the fastest Mining experience from level 45 onwards.

Mining.name: Motherlode Mine
Mining.summary: Mining in the Motherlode Mine is a profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods.

Mining.name: Gem rocks
Mining.summary: Mining gem rocks is a profitable alternative that offers comparable experience rates to granite when using tick manipulation.

Mining.name: Calcified rocks
Mining.summary: Mining calcified rocks in the Cam Torum Mine is a low-effort alternative to the faster methods.

Mining.name: Rubium rocks
Mining.summary: Mining rubium rocks in the Charred Dungeon offers a low-effort and profitable, but slower alternative for players wishing to avoid tick manipulation.

Mining.name: Crashed stars
Mining.summary: Mining crashed stars is a very low-effort alternative to the faster methods.

Mining.name: Lead rocks
Mining.summary: Lead rocks can be found within Deepfin Mine, accessible with level 67 Sailing.

Mining.name: Volcanic Mine
Mining.summary: The Volcanic Mine minigame on Fossil Island is a fairly low-effort alternative that offers relatively fast experience.

Mining.name: Zalcano
Mining.summary: Zalcano is a demon imprisoned beneath Prifddinas that is fought using skilling rather than conventional combat.

Mining.name: Blast Mine
Mining.summary: The Blast Mine minigame is a profitable alternative that offers fast experience.

Mining.name: Amethyst
Mining.summary: Amethyst crystals are an alternative choice for players looking to mine with low effort or click intensity, albeit for very slow experience rates.

Prayer.name: Offering bones at a gilded altar
Prayer.summary: The fastest way to train Prayer is to offer bones at a gilded altar in a player-owned house.

Prayer.name: Offering blessed bone shards to the libation bowl
Prayer.summary: Requiring level 30 Prayer, offering blessed bone shards to the libation bowl within the Teomat is slightly slower, but offers more experience per bone compared to the gilded altar.

Prayer.name: Offering bones at the Chaos Temple
Prayer.summary: Offering bones at the altar within the Wilderness' Chaos Temple is a slightly slower but much cheaper alternative to the gilded altar in a POH.

Prayer.name: Reanimating ensouled heads
Prayer.summary: Reanimating ensouled heads and killing the reanimated monsters near the Dark Altar is a relatively slow training method, but it requires less effort than manually offering bones at a gilded altar or the Chaos altar.

Prayer.name: Offering spells
Prayer.summary: With the upgraded Arceuus spellbook from A Kingdom Divided, players can offer bones or demonic ashes from their inventory, offering simultaneous Magic experience.

Ranged.name: Using dwarf multicannon
Ranged.summary: Using the dwarf multicannon, once assembled, offers the fastest experience up to level 45.

Ranged.name: Chinning maniacal monkeys
Ranged.summary: For more information, see Maniacal monkey/Strategies.

Ranged.name: Pest Control
Ranged.summary: Participating at the Pest Control minigame and spending Void Knight commendation points on Ranged experience is an alternative training method at higher levels.

Ranged.name: Monkeys with Venator bow
Ranged.summary: As a cheaper (albeit slower) alternative to Chinning, the Venator bow can be used with Amethyst arrows to kill either Skeleton monkeys or Maniacal monkeys to get experience rates between 140,000 and 230,000 per hour.

Runecraft.name: Making talisman tiaras
Runecraft.summary: Making talisman tiaras is one of the fastest training methods up to level 50.

Runecraft.name: Lava runes
Runecraft.summary: Lava runes are made by visiting the Fire Altar with essence and at least an equal number of earth runes.

Runecraft.name: Essence runner methods
Runecraft.summary: missing setups and more accurate gp/xp calcs

Runecraft.name: Guardians of the Rift
Runecraft.summary: The Guardians of the Rift minigame is an alternative way of training Runecraft.

Runecraft.name: Ourania Altar
Runecraft.summary: Crafting runes at the Ourania Altar (also known as the ZMI Altar) is a profitable lower-effort alternative to lava runes.

Runecraft.name: Crafting blood/soul runes in Arceuus
Runecraft.summary: caption: Location of the Dense essence mine

Runecraft.name: Arceuus Library
Runecraft.summary: Helping customers in the Arceuus Library is a viable Runecraft training method that has no requirements.

Runecraft.name: Other combination runes
Runecraft.summary: Crafting other combination runes is a profitable alternative to lava runes.

Runecraft.name: Double astral runes
Runecraft.summary: Crafting double astral runes can yield good profit depending on the rune prices.

Runecraft.name: Double nature runes
Runecraft.summary: For more information about runecrafting through the Abyss, see Abyss/Strategies.

Runecraft.name: Aether runes
Runecraft.summary: }}If you're not 99 runecrafting make sure to attach a cosmic or catalytic tiara to the Hat of the Eye.

Runecraft.name: Wrath runes
Runecraft.summary: Crafting wrath runes is a profitable alternative to the faster methods.

Sailing.name: Sea charting
Sailing.summary: Sea charting is a method of training Sailing by performing specific tasks across Gielinor's oceans.

Sailing.name: Rellekka route
Sailing.summary: At level 62, this route is estimated to provide approximately 66,000 Sailing experience per hour with only Rellekka unlocked.

Sailing.name: Shipwreck salvaging
Sailing.summary: Salvaging is a low-intensity gathering activity which involves sailing to sunken shipwrecks across the ocean and using a salvaging hook to collect resources from them.

Sailing.name: Deep sea trawling
Sailing.summary: Deep sea trawling is a hybrid Fishing and Sailing activity, where players fish at trawling shoals using their boat's trawling nets.

Slayer.name: Temple Trekking
Slayer.summary: Aside from quest rewards and traditional slayer training, the Temple Trekking minigame can provide Slayer XP at a low hourly rate via the XP rewards, alongside Agility, Firemaking, Fishing, Mining, Thieving, and Woodcutting.

Smithing.name: Anvil smithing
Smithing.summary: From level 1 to 40, smith various items at the anvil just south of the west Varrock bank.

Smithing.name: Blast Furnace gold bars
Smithing.summary: Smelting gold bars at the Blast Furnace becomes the fastest viable training method at level 40.

Smithing.name: Giants' Foundry
Smithing.summary: Forging swords at the Giants' Foundry minigame is a lower-effort alternative to the faster methods.

Smithing.name: Smithing dart tips and nails
Smithing.summary: Smithing dart tips and nails offers slow experience, but it requires little attention.

Smithing.name: Smithing steel cannonballs
Smithing.summary: Smithing steel cannonballs offers even slower experience than dart tips, but requires even less attention, and usually makes a profit.

Smithing.name: Smithing armour
Smithing.summary: Smithing armour at an anvil is only recommended for account builds that cannot get goldsmith gauntlets.

Smithing.name: Smithing 3-bar rune items
Smithing.summary: Smithing rune platelegs, plateskirts, or 2h swords at an anvil offers decent experience, and it is also profitable.

Strength.name: Sulphur Naguas
Strength.summary: requirements: Partial completion of Perilous Moons (includes {{SCP

Strength.name: Maniacal monkeys with Hallowfell
Strength.summary: See Maniacal monkey/Strategies for more information.name: Maniacal monkey

Thieving.name: Chambers of Xeric thieving room
Thieving.summary: From level 1 to 45, you can train Thieving in the Chambers of Xeric raid atop Mount Quidamortem in the Kebos Lowlands.

Thieving.name: Blackjacking
Thieving.summary: Blackjacking bandits in Pollnivneach offers the fastest experience from level 45 to 49, and then from level 65 to 84.

Thieving.name: Stealing from Rogues' Castle chests
Thieving.summary: Stealing from Rogues' Castle chests in the Wilderness offers the fastest Thieving experience from level 84 onwards.

notes: One option needs Icthlarin's Little Helper

Thieving.name: Bakery stalls
Thieving.summary: From level 5 to 25, steal from the eastern bakery stall in East Ardougne market.

Thieving.name: Fruit stalls
Thieving.summary: From level 25 to 50, steal from fruit stalls in Hosidius.

Thieving.name: Stealing valuables in Varlamore
Thieving.summary: Stealing valuables in Civitas illa Fortis is a low-effort alternative to the faster methods, allowing for significant AFK time.

Thieving.name: Knights of Ardougne
Thieving.summary: Pickpocketing Knights of Ardougne is a slower but more straightforward alternative to the faster training methods.

Thieving.name: Dorgesh-Kaan rich chests
Thieving.summary: Stealing from the rich chests in Dorgesh-Kaan is a fairly low-effort alternative that offers decent experience.

Thieving.name: Sorceress's Garden
Thieving.summary: The Sorceress's Garden minigame consists of navigating through a maze while avoiding guardians to pick fruit and squeeze them into juice.

Thieving.name: Pickpocketing vyres
Thieving.summary: Pickpocketing vyres at level 82 with rogue equipment, dodgy necklaces, and the hard Ardougne Diary completed will get 120,000-180,000 experience per hour and profit Pickpocketing vyres coins per hour, depending on Thieving level.

Thieving.name: Pickpocketing elves
Thieving.summary: Pickpocketing elves in Prifddinas is a slower but profitable alternative after completing Song of the Elves.

Thieving.name: Stealing from Port Roberts stalls
Thieving.summary: With 50 Sailing, players can steal from the stalls in Port Roberts.

Thieving.name: Master Farmers
Thieving.summary: At level 94 and after completing the hard Ardougne Diary, players can pickpocket Master Farmers at 100% success rate.

Thieving.name: TzHaar-Hur
Thieving.summary: Pickpocketing TzHaar-Hur in the inner part of Mor Ul Rek is a viable option past level 99.

Woodcutting.name: Teak trees
Woodcutting.summary: Cutting teak trees offers the fastest Woodcutting experience in the game when using tick manipulation.

Woodcutting.name: Forestry events
Woodcutting.summary: Participating in Forestry events offers decent Woodcutting experience and some profit from purchasing the rewards with anima-infused bark.

Woodcutting.name: Blisterwood tree
Woodcutting.summary: Cutting the blisterwood tree in Darkmeyer becomes a viable low-effort alternative at level 62.

Woodcutting.name: Sulliuscep
Woodcutting.summary: Cutting sulliuscep mushroom trees on Fossil Island is a low-effort alternative that offers fast experience without using tick manipulation.

Woodcutting.name: Bloodwood trees
Woodcutting.summary: After completion of The Blood Moon Rises, players can cut Bloodwood trees in Vampyrium, gaining around 130,000-210,000 experience per hour when cutting three trees at a time with a Dragon felling axe.

Woodcutting.name: Ironwood trees
Woodcutting.summary: With 72 Sailing players can cut Ironwood trees on Sunbleak island gaining around 80,000 experience per hour with a dragon axe.

Woodcutting.name: Redwood trees
Woodcutting.summary: Cutting redwood trees in the Woodcutting Guild requires very little attention and offers decent experience.

Woodcutting.name: Rosewood trees
Woodcutting.summary: Cutting rosewood trees is a very low-effort alternative to the faster methods.
